title: OMGs Vanilla Mische
description: An opinionated collection of client-side mods improving visuals, quality of life, and other helpful utilities.
body:
![OMG's Vanilla Mische](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/392956ae6ddbb3bd51ec4855bf60907fa68e372f.png) This modpack, like [Fabulously Optimized](https://modrinth.com/modpack/fabulously-optimized), contains only client-side mods that deliver a broad range of **performance improvements** and **visual enhancements**. In addition, unlike Fabulously Optimized, it features numerous **quality-of-life** mods designed to speed up and simplify various aspects of vanilla gameplay.

> ⚠️ **WARNING:** \ > This modpack contains only client-side mods, but some QoL Mods like Freecam may be considered cheating on many servers. Use this pack only on servers that clearly allow these types of client-side mods.
![separator line](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f7eb4e47ff4874fd802d0824bc9b691ed0c32c68.png)
### Key Features - ✨ Shader Support - 📦 Various Texture Pack Enhancements - 🌄 Increased Render Distance - 🗺️ Map and Minimap - 📍 Waypoints - 📹 Freecam - 🖨️ Blueprints and Schematics - 🪽 Automatic Elytra Swapping - ☀️ Light Level Overlay - 🕶️ Fullbright Mode - 📗 Improved Recipe Book - 💡 Food, Shulker Box, and Map Tooltips - 🔮 Enchantment Calculator - 🔢 Chat Calculator
![separator line](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f7eb4e47ff4874fd802d0824bc9b691ed0c32c68.png)
### Credits Vanilla Tweaks: https://vanillatweaks.net/ > For a **list of included mods, resource packs, and shaders**, see the Dependencies section under the [latest version](https://modrinth.com/modpack/omgsvanillamische/version/latest).
